subject: general
question:
When a wire is bent into the shape of a square, the area of the square is 81 cm². When the wire is bent into a semi-circular shape, what will be the area of the semicircle?

[Take pi = (22)/(7)]
solution:
**Given:**

Area = 81 cm²

**Concept used:**

Area of semicircle= πr²/2

**Calculations:**

Area of square = (side)²

⇒ Side = sqrt{81} = 9 cm

⇒ Now we find the length of the wire

&rA
